ja: • 1968年の東北本線青森電化と山陽・九州地区の特急列車増発に合わせ、当時大好評だった581系を発展させて製造。
• 交直流両用、50/60ヘルツ両用で日本全国の電化幹線区間が走行可能に。
• 東北地方に備えた寒冷地仕様。
• クハネ583形とモハネ582形は581系との違いを明確に作り分け。
• 付属のヘッドマークシールは往年の東北本線、常磐線が中心。寝台列車だけでなく昼行特急列車も再現可能。
• 増結セット（別売り）を追加すれば、各年代の姿が再現できる。
en: • In line with the electrification of Aomori on the Tohoku Main Line in 1968 and the increase in the number of limited express trains in the Sanyo and Kyushu areas, the 581 series, which was very popular at the time, was developed and produced.
• Can run on electrified trunk lines across the country with dual AC/DC and 50/60 Hz dual use.
• Cold region specifications for the Tohoku region.
• Kuhane 583 type and Mohane 582 type are clearly differentiated from the 581 series.
• The attached head mark seals are mainly for the Tohoku Main Line and Joban Line. Not only sleeper trains but also daytime express trains can be reproduced.
• By adding additional sets (sold separately), you can recreate the appearance of each generation.
